info.name: E-Commerce Platform API — v1
info.description: REST API of the core application (Laravel). Damascus University — Internet Applications project 2026.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: JWT authentication. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

request.description:
Creates a **customer** account and logs it in. Sending `role` has no effect.
Limited to 10 registrations per minute per IP.

response.body: {"error": {"code": "VALIDATION_FAILED", "message": "The given data was invalid.", "details": {"email": ["The email has already been taken."], "password": ["The password field must be at least 8 characters."]}}}
response.name: Email taken / weak password

request.description:
Limited to **5 attempts per minute** for the same email and IP (then 429 with `Retry-After`).
The error is the same whether the email exists or not.
Returns a new token. **The old token stops working immediately.**
The current token is blacklisted: using it again returns 401.

Newest first, paginated. Stock is read from the inventory service in **one call for the whole page**.
If the inventory service is down the list still works and `stock.status` is `unavailable`.

request.description:
The quantity is asked from the inventory service at request time.
`stock.status`: `in_stock`, `out_of_stock`, or `unavailable` (inventory service down, `quantity` is null).

One call to the inventory service reserves **every** item (all or nothing).
Prices always come from the database: any price sent by the client is ignored.
If saving the order fails after the reservation, the stock is given back.
Limited to 10 orders per minute per user.

response.body: {"error": {"code": "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "message": "Some products do not have enough stock.", "details": {"items": [{"product_id": 3, "name": "Smart Watch", "requested": 2, "available": 1}]}}}
response.name: Not enough stock (no order created)

response.body: {"error": {"code": "VALIDATION_FAILED", "message": "The given data was invalid.", "details": {"items.0.quantity": ["The items.0.quantity field must be at least 1."]}}}
{"error": {"code": "INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE", "message": "The inventory service is not available right now. Please try again later.", "details": {}}}
response.name: Inventory service down (no order created)

query.description: One of pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled.

request.description: A customer gets **only their own** orders. An admin gets every order, plus `customer` and `next_statuses`.
Only the owner or an admin. **Another customer's order returns 403.**

response.body: {"error": {"code": "FORBIDDEN", "message": "You are not allowed to view this order.", "details": {}}}
response.name: Someone else's order

request.description:
Newest first. `meta.unread_count` holds the number of unread notifications.
Types: `order.placed` (customer), `order.new` (admins), `order.status_changed` (order owner).

request.description:
**Admin only.** `multipart/form-data` with the image. The initial quantity is sent to the inventory service;
if that fails nothing is saved (no product row, no image) and 503 is returned.

request.description:
**Admin only** (a customer gets 403, even on their own order).
Allowed: pending → confirmed | cancelled, confirmed → shipped | cancelled, shipped → delivered.
Cancelling gives the stock back to the inventory service. The customer is notified.
